basics.name: Yitong Bai
basics.label: M.S. Student in Computer Engineering, Columbia University
basics.summary: Research interests: LLM agents, multi-agent systems, ML systems, evaluation and verification, reproducibility, trustworthy and human-centered AI.

work.name: Columbia University, CRIS Lab
highlights: Developed DeepAudit, an LLM-agent framework for automated reproducibility auditing of ML papers and companion code.
Engineered claim extraction, environment provisioning, autonomous execution, LLM-driven replanning, and tolerance-aware verdict generation.

work.name: Columbia University / IBM Research Collaboration
work.summary: Mentored by Dhaval Patel, Senior Technical Staff Member, IBM Research
highlights: Proposed and optimized a Supervisor-Specialist multi-agent architecture for multi-turn industrial asset operations.
Designed cross-turn artifact memory for asset state, diagnostic hypotheses, action history, and reusable tool evidence.

work.name: Neusoft Group
highlights: Contributed to development and testing for a university portal system, including frontend refinement, database interface support, and cross-database data matching.

publications.name: Application and Analysis of the VGG16 Model in Facial Emotion Recognition
